body.name: Memory
body.tagline: Store and recall persistent memory across sessions using a local knowledge graph.
body.description:
Memory is a reference MCP server that gives an assistant a knowledge-graph-based persistent memory. Information is kept between conversations so the assistant can recall it later.

It runs locally over stdio with npx (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory) and is configured in an MCP client such as Claude Desktop. No API key is listed. The maintainers describe the repository's servers as reference implementations for learning, not production-ready solutions.

access.label: Local
access.note: Runs on your machine: its page has the install command

body.verified_by: Verified by mcp.tc: official server from MCP reference servers

add.label: Claude Code
add.value: claude mcp add --transport stdio memory -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
